# Pelli Kathalu by Prem & Pavan

> Hyderabad-based wedding photography and cinematography studio. Portraits, pre-weddings, weddings and events — "Captured the way they feel."

## About
Pelli Kathalu is a creative studio run by co-founders and photographers **Prem Chandra** and **Pavan** in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. What started as two friends with cameras grew into a Hyderabad wedding photography and cinematography brand built on storytelling: unposed, documentary, emotional images and films.

## Services
- Wedding photography and films (Hyderabad and travel)
- Pre-wedding shoots
- Portrait sessions (individuals, celebrities, personalities)
- Documentary-style wedding coverage
